settings.name: Segmentation method
settings.description: Choose a data-driven Hidden Markov Model or the rule-based criteria segmentation implemented by the hmmcma C++ backend.

settings.name: Number of states
settings.description: HMM: number of latent states. Criteria method: number of semicolon-separated rules in Criteria rules.

settings.name: HMM features
settings.description: Comma-separated feature numbers (HMM only): 1 SPEED, 2 DISTANCE, 3 TURN ANGLE, 4 DIRECTION, 5 ANGULAR DIFFERENCE, 6 PERSISTENCE VELOCITY, 7 TERRAIN. Example: 1,3. TERRAIN requires a numeric terrain column.

settings.name: Criteria rules
settings.description: Criteria method only. One rule per state, separated by semicolons: label:criterion=value. Combine criteria within a rule with & (all), | (any), or prefix one with ! (not). Available criteria: disk (metres), minimum_hops, maximum_hops, minimum_duration (seconds), speed (m/s range), turning_angle (degree range), heading (degree range), and the *_with_outliers variants with threshold,outlier-count. Example: resting:disk=100; travelling:minimum_hops=2&heading=35; foraging:maximum_hops=6

settings.name: Fill with last state
settings.description: Carry the last modelled state forward into otherwise unmodelled fixes, separately for each trajectory. If disabled, unmodelled fixes keep state -1.
